title: Mesken Consulting
summary: Mesken Consulting helps students navigate international admissions, visa preparation, and study abroad planning.
shortDescription: A conversion-focused website for an education consultancy helping students study abroad.

overview: Mesken Consulting helps students pursue international education through admissions guidance, visa preparation, and study abroad support.
The website needed to present the consultancy's services clearly while building trust with prospective students and parents.
contribution: Built the frontend with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Structured the page experience around lead generation and clear service discovery.
Integrated Sanity CMS so the client can manage page content, testimonials, blogs, events, and global site settings.
Implemented responsive layouts, SEO metadata, sitemap support, and contact/consultation flows.
challenges: The site needed to communicate credibility quickly for students and families making high-stakes education decisions.
The content system had to give the client editing control without making the website harder to maintain.
The booking and contact flows needed to feel simple, reliable, and conversion-focused across devices.
approach: Designed a clear homepage structure that moves visitors from brand introduction to services, destinations, testimonials, FAQs, and consultation booking.
Built reusable page sections and shared components to keep the interface consistent across the website.
Connected the website to Sanity CMS for editable written content, testimonials, blogs, events, footer text, and SEO fields.
Added form validation, email delivery, confirmation emails, and Calendly handoff for consultation bookings.
outcome: The final platform gives Mesken Consulting a professional, CMS-powered website with clear service messaging and reliable lead-generation paths.
Prospective students can understand the offer, read success stories, submit enquiries, and book consultations from a responsive experience.
caseStudy.pullQuote: For education consulting, clarity is part of the product experience.
